title: Sound function in hard techno
description: Preliminary research, in plain language: which measurable things tell you whether a sound is a kick, a rumble, a hat, a clap, a hook or a riser — and a programme for finding out ten times more.

title: An expanded corpus and the first listening test
description: Part two of the sound-function research: a labelled library of 718 sounds, a browser role meter, a listening test, the pump measured, and hundreds of hard techno tracks with bar one found.

title: Source-separated stems and pump measurements
description: Part three: 218 hard techno tracks split into stems with a free separator; the pump measured three ways, where real kicks land, and real hits against the synthetic ones.

title: A doubled corpus and a register of tested hypotheses
description: Part four: the literature doubled, the corpus grown, a register of tested hypotheses with two reversals, loudness measured for the first time, and two more notes on where this goes.

title: Re-scoring the HumTrans humming benchmark
description: What a public humming dataset shows about humming transcription: the published scores measured a delay, not the models, and what is still hard once the delay is fixed.

title: Counting the video games of 2024
description: A count of the video games first released in 2024, with its error range. It also finds the critic score where acclaim begins.

title: How much room a hook takes up in music space
description: A toy model of melodic space, with no real songs yet. It measures how much room one record claims and who owns the popular ground.

title: Building Open Net Battle on an Apple Silicon Mac
description: We built a fan-made battle game engine from source on an Apple Silicon Mac mini. Seven small patches and one launch option took it from download to a real battle.

title: Room World in Bevy: a trial
description: Room World rebuilt in Bevy: nine real rooms, and a first game in them. Find five orbs with the drone and open the way to the capybara. A second, ?game=keys, saves to your own Bluesky repo.

title: From references to release: a production map
description: How zpkt makes a hard techno Short, drawn as a land map: eight stages from references to release, each piece of work coloured by whether it is built, partly built or still missing.

title: Fuzz, not a click: matching a kick's texture
description: HW002's kick had the references' mid-high energy but not their fuzz. Measuring the texture of a kick's mid-highs, finding the device that turned fuzz into a click, and folding the kick's punch until it matched.
